snippet.title: I Am Bird - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Play as a bird hero - the city is your playground. Fly through the streets, help citizens and your bird crew. Keep danger away. Fly, glide, and maneuver through the skies and streets. Protect the city using unique skills and gadgets. Watch the I Am Bird trailer to see chaotic gameplay.
